title: EX-ANTE ASSESSMENT OF DISCRIMINATION IN DATASET
findings: Religion is mentioned once in the abstract as an example of a sensitive demographic attribute for which the proposed method could identify bias risk. However, the actual experiments and datasets used in the paper focus on race and gender, not religion. Consequently, there are no findings related to religion.
